name: rate-limit-guard
description: At 90% of the 5-hour limit, tells the orchestrator and every subagent to checkpoint and stop at a safe point, then resumes them after the window resets.

threshold.title: Threshold (%)
threshold.description: Percent of the 5-hour window at which to start the checkpoint-and-stop.

checkpointDir.title: Checkpoint directory
checkpointDir.description: Where agents write their checkpoint files, relative to the project.

autoResume.title: Auto-resume
autoResume.description: After the window resets, prompt the orchestrator to read the checkpoints and continue.

resumeBufferSeconds.title: Resume buffer (s)
resumeBufferSeconds.description: Extra seconds to wait after the reset time before resuming.
